<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Scientific Calculator</title>
<style>
:root{
  --bg:#e9ecea; --body:#f7f8f6; --screen:#1f2a26; --screen-text:#e8f3ec; --screen-dim:#8fa69a;
  --key:#ffffff; --key-text:#1d2421; --fn:#d5ddd8; --op:#2f6f5a; --op-text:#fff; --eq:#e0a43a; --eq-text:#2a1d05;
  --shadow:#b9c2bd; --hist:#5a6761;
  box-sizing:border-box; padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px); padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px);
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark){
  :root:not([data-theme="light"]){
    --bg:#121614; --body:#1b211e; --screen:#0c0f0e; --screen-text:#e8f3ec; --screen-dim:#7d948a;
    --key:#28312d; --key-text:#e8f0ec; --fn:#35403b; --op:#3f8f75; --op-text:#06130e; --eq:#e0a43a; --eq-text:#2a1d05;
    --shadow:#0a0d0c; --hist:#8fa69a;
  }
}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{
  --bg:#121614; --body:#1b211e; --screen:#0c0f0e; --screen-text:#e8f3ec; --screen-dim:#7d948a;
  --key:#28312d; --key-text:#e8f0ec; --fn:#35403b; --op:#3f8f75; --op-text:#06130e; --eq:#e0a43a; --eq-text:#2a1d05;
  --shadow:#0a0d0c; --hist:#8fa69a;
}
:root[data-theme="ios"]{
  --bg:#000; --body:#000; --screen:#000; --screen-text:#fff; --screen-dim:#8e8e93;
  --key:#333333; --key-text:#fff; --fn:#a5a5a5; --fn-text:#000; --op:#ff9f0a; --op-text:#fff; --eq:#ff9f0a; --eq-text:#fff;
  --shadow:#000; --hist:#8e8e93; --kr:999px; --kr2:999px;
}
:root[data-theme="android"]{
  --bg:#f3edf7; --body:#fef7ff; --screen:#e8def8; --screen-text:#1d1b20; --screen-dim:#6b6573;
  --key:#ece6f0; --key-text:#1d1b20; --fn:#d9cff0; --fn-text:#4a4458; --op:#6750a4; --op-text:#fff; --eq:#d0bcff; --eq-text:#21005d;
  --shadow:#d9d0e3; --hist:#6b6573; --kr:24px; --kr2:16px;
}
:root[data-theme="rose"]{
  --bg:#fbeaf0; --body:#fff6f9; --screen:#5b1e36; --screen-text:#ffeaf2; --screen-dim:#d9a3b9;
  --key:#ffffff; --key-text:#3d1424; --fn:#f6cddc; --op:#c2456f; --op-text:#fff; --eq:#f2a65a; --eq-text:#3a1d05;
  --shadow:#e8bccb; --hist:#8a4a62;
}
:root[data-theme="ocean"]{
  --bg:#e3eef7; --body:#f4f9fd; --screen:#0f2a43; --screen-text:#e6f3ff; --screen-dim:#8fb3d1;
  --key:#ffffff; --key-text:#0f2233; --fn:#cfe0ee; --op:#1f6fb2; --op-text:#fff; --eq:#f0b429; --eq-text:#2a1d05;
  --shadow:#b5c9da; --hist:#52708a;
}
:root[data-theme="forest"]{
  --bg:#e6ede2; --body:#f5f8f2; --screen:#1e2d1f; --screen-text:#e9f5e6; --screen-dim:#96b394;
  --key:#ffffff; --key-text:#1c261c; --fn:#d3dfcc; --op:#4a7c3a; --op-text:#fff; --eq:#d99a2b; --eq-text:#2a1d05;
  --shadow:#b8c6b0; --hist:#5d7058;
}
.top select{border:0;background:var(--fn);color:var(--fn-text,var(--key-text));border-radius:999px;padding:6px 10px;font:inherit;font-size:13px;cursor:pointer}
html{scroll-padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
body{margin:0;min-height:100vh;background:var(--bg);color:var(--key-text);
  font-family:"DM Sans",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:16px}
.calc{width:100%;max-width:380px;background:var(--body);border-radius:22px;padding:14px;
  box-shadow:0 2px 0 var(--shadow),0 18px 40px -18px var(--shadow)}
.top{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin:2px 4px 10px}
.top div{flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:flex-end}
.top b{font-size:15px;font-weight:600}
.top div{display:flex;gap:6px}
.top button{border:0;background:var(--fn);color:var(--key-text);border-radius:999px;padding:6px 12px;font:inherit;font-size:13px;cursor:pointer}
.screen{background:var(--screen);border-radius:14px;padding:12px 16px;min-height:110px;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end;align-items:flex-end;overflow:hidden}
.hist,.expr{width:100%;text-align:right;color:var(--screen-dim);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.hist{font-size:14px;min-height:20px}
.expr{font-size:18px;min-height:24px}
.out{font-size:44px;font-weight:600;color:var(--screen-text);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;line-height:1.15;max-width:100%;white-space:nowrap}
.sci{display:none;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:7px;margin-top:12px}
.sci.on{display:grid}
.keys{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:9px;margin-top:12px}
button{-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
.keys button,.sci button{border:0;font:inherit;font-weight:500;cursor:pointer;color:var(--key-text);
  box-shadow:0 2px 0 var(--shadow);transition:transform .06s}
.keys button{height:60px;border-radius:var(--kr,14px);font-size:22px;background:var(--key)}
.sci button{height:44px;border-radius:var(--kr2,11px);font-size:15px;background:var(--fn);color:var(--fn-text,var(--key-text))}
.keys button:active,.sci button:active{transform:translateY(2px);box-shadow:none}
.keys .fn{background:var(--fn);color:var(--fn-text,var(--key-text))}
.keys .op,.sci .op{background:var(--op);color:var(--op-text)}
.calc{border-radius:var(--kr2,22px)}
.screen{border-radius:var(--kr2,14px)}
.keys .eq{background:var(--eq);color:var(--eq-text)}
.keys .zero{grid-column:span 2}
.keys .small{height:44px;font-size:18px}
.keys .del2{grid-column:span 2}
button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--eq);outline-offset:2px}
.hint{margin:12px 4px 2px;font-size:12px;color:var(--hist);text-align:center}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.keys button,.sci button{transition:none}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<main class="calc" aria-label="Scientific calculator">
  <div class="top"><b>Calculator</b>
    <div>
      <button id="sciToggle" type="button" aria-label="Show or hide scientific keys">Sci</button>
      <button id="deg" type="button" aria-label="Switch between degrees and radians">Deg</button>
      <select id="snd" aria-label="Sound">
        <option value="real">🧾 Recorded</option><option value="mech">⌨️ Mechanical</option><option value="calc">🧮 Calculator</option><option value="beep">🔊 Beep</option><option value="off">🔇 Mute</option>
      </select>
      <select id="themeSel" aria-label="Theme">
        <option value="auto">Auto</option><option value="light">Light</option><option value="dark">Dark</option>
        <option value="ios">iOS</option><option value="android">Android</option>
        <option value="rose">Rose</option><option value="ocean">Ocean</option><option value="forest">Forest</option>
      </select>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="screen" aria-live="polite">
    <div class="hist" id="hist"></div>
    <div class="expr" id="expr"></div>
    <div class="out" id="out">0</div>
  </div>
  <div class="sci on" id="sci">
    <button data-f="sin">sin</button><button data-f="cos">cos</button><button data-f="tan">tan</button><button data-f="pi">π</button><button data-f="e">e</button>
    <button data-f="asin">sin⁻¹</button><button data-f="acos">cos⁻¹</button><button data-f="atan">tan⁻¹</button><button data-f="ln">ln</button><button data-f="log">log</button>
    <button data-f="sqrt">√</button><button data-f="sq">x²</button><button class="op" data-k="^">xʸ</button><button data-f="inv">1/x</button><button data-f="fact">n!</button>
  </div>
  <div class="keys" id="keys">
    <button class="fn" data-k="AC">AC</button><button class="fn" data-k="±">±</button><button class="fn" data-k="%">%</button><button class="op" data-k="÷">÷</button>
    <button data-k="7">7</button><button data-k="8">8</button><button data-k="9">9</button><button class="op" data-k="×">×</button>
    <button data-k="4">4</button><button data-k="5">5</button><button data-k="6">6</button><button class="op" data-k="−">−</button>
    <button data-k="1">1</button><button data-k="2">2</button><button data-k="3">3</button><button class="op" data-k="+">+</button>
    <button class="zero" data-k="0">0</button><button data-k=".">.</button><button class="eq" data-k="=">=</button>
    <button class="fn small" data-k="(">(</button><button class="fn small" data-k=")">)</button><button class="fn small del2" data-k="⌫">⌫ Delete</button>
  </div>
  <p class="hint">Keyboard works too: digits, + − * / ^ ( ), Enter, Backspace, Esc</p>
</main>
<script>
(function(){
  var toks=[],result=null,justEq=false,err=false,lastCalc="",lastExpr="",deg=true;
  var OPS="+−×÷^",POST=["²","!","%","⁻¹"];
  var out=document.getElementById("out"),expr=document.getElementById("expr"),hist=document.getElementById("hist");

  function fmt(s){
    if(s==="Error"||/e/.test(s)) return s;
    var neg=s[0]==="-",t=neg?s.slice(1):s,p=t.split(".");
    return (neg?"-":"")+p[0].replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g,",")+(p.length>1?"."+p[1]:"");
  }
  function num(x){
    if(!isFinite(x)) return "Error";
    var s=String(parseFloat(x.toPrecision(12)));
    if(s.indexOf("e")>-1) s=x.toExponential(6).replace(/\.?0+e/,"e");
    return s;
  }
  function isNum(s){ return s!==undefined&&/^(\d+\.?\d*|\.\d+)(e[+-]?\d+)?$/.test(s); }
  function isOpen(s){ return s!==undefined&&s.charAt(s.length-1)==="("; }
  function isOp(s){ return s!==undefined&&s.length===1&&OPS.indexOf(s)>-1; }
  function last(){ return toks[toks.length-1]; }
  function endsOperand(){ var l=last(); return l!==undefined&&(isNum(l)||l===")"||l==="π"||l==="e"||POST.indexOf(l)>-1); }
  function depth(){ var d=0; toks.forEach(function(t){ if(isOpen(t)) d++; else if(t===")") d--; }); return d; }
  function disp(t){ return {"asin(":"sin⁻¹(","acos(":"cos⁻¹(","atan(":"tan⁻¹("}[t]||t; }
  function toStr(){
    var s="";
    for(var i=0;i<toks.length;i++){
      var t=toks[i];
      var bin=isOp(t)&&((t!=="+"&&t!=="−")||(i>0&&!isOp(toks[i-1])&&!isOpen(toks[i-1])));
      s+=bin?" "+t+" ":disp(t);
    }
    return s;
  }
  function tail(s,n){ return s.length>n?"…"+s.slice(-(n-1)):s; }
  function render(){
    var big,small,h;
    if(justEq||err){ small=lastExpr+(err?"":" ="); big=fmt(result); h=""; }
    else { small=""; big=toks.length?toStr():"0"; h=lastCalc; }
    var L=big.length;
    out.style.fontSize=(L>24?18:L>19?22:L>15?28:L>11?34:L>8?38:44)+"px";
    out.textContent=tail(big,30); expr.textContent=tail(small,30); hist.textContent=tail(h,34);
  }
  function clearAll(){ toks=[];result=null;justEq=false;err=false;lastExpr="";render(); }
  function ansToks(){ return result.charAt(0)==="-"?["−",result.slice(1)]:[result]; }
  function begin(){
    if(justEq&&!err) lastCalc=lastExpr+" = "+fmt(result);
    if(justEq||err){ toks=[];result=null;justEq=false;err=false; }
  }
  function cont(){
    if(justEq&&!err){ lastCalc=lastExpr+" = "+fmt(result); toks=ansToks(); result=null; justEq=false; }
  }
  function digit(d){
    begin();
    var l=last();
    if(l!==undefined&&l!==""&&/^\d*\.?\d*$/.test(l)){
      if(d==="."){ if(l.indexOf(".")>-1) return; toks[toks.length-1]=l+"."; }
      else if(l==="0") toks[toks.length-1]=d;
      else if(l.replace(".","").length<15) toks[toks.length-1]=l+d;
    } else {
      if(endsOperand()) toks.push("×");
      toks.push(d==="."?"0.":d);
    }
    render();
  }
  function operator(o){
    if(err) return;
    cont();
    var l=last();
    if(l===undefined){
      if(o==="−"||o==="+") toks.push(o); else { toks.push("0"); toks.push(o); }
    } else if(isOpen(l)){
      if(o==="−"||o==="+") toks.push(o);
    } else if(isOp(l)){
      if(o==="−"&&(l==="×"||l==="÷"||l==="^")) toks.push(o);
      else {
        while(isOp(last())) toks.pop();
        var l2=last();
        if(l2===undefined||isOpen(l2)){ if(o==="−"||o==="+") toks.push(o); }
        else toks.push(o);
      }
    } else toks.push(o);
    render();
  }
  function postfix(p){
    if(err) return;
    cont();
    if(!endsOperand()) return;
    toks.push(p); render();
  }
  function openTok(tok){
    if(!err&&!justEq&&depth()>=20) return;
    begin();
    if(endsOperand()) toks.push("×");
    toks.push(tok); render();
  }
  function closeParen(){
    if(err||justEq) return;
    var l=last();
    if(depth()<=0||l===undefined||isOp(l)||isOpen(l)) return;
    toks.push(")"); render();
  }
  function sign(){
    if(err) return;
    cont();
    var j=toks.length-1;
    while(j>=0&&POST.indexOf(toks[j])>-1) j--;
    if(j<0) return;
    var t=toks[j],start;
    if(t===")"){
      var d=0;
      for(var k=j;k>=0;k--){
        if(toks[k]===")") d++;
        else if(isOpen(toks[k])){ d--; if(d===0){ start=k; break; } }
      }
      if(start===undefined) return;
    } else if(isNum(t)||t==="π"||t==="e") start=j;
    else return;
    var p=start-1;
    if(p>=0&&toks[p]==="−"&&(p===0||isOp(toks[p-1])||isOpen(toks[p-1]))) toks.splice(p,1);
    else toks.splice(start,0,"−");
    render();
  }
  function back(){
    if(err){ clearAll(); return; }
    if(justEq){ justEq=false; result=null; render(); return; }
    var l=last();
    if(l===undefined) return;
    if(/^\d*\.?\d*$/.test(l)&&l.length>1) toks[toks.length-1]=l.slice(0,-1);
    else toks.pop();
    render();
  }
  function fact(n){ if(n<0||n>170||n%1!==0) return NaN; var r=1; for(var i=2;i<=n;i++) r*=i; return r; }
  function rd(v){ return deg?v*Math.PI/180:v; }
  function dd(){ return deg?180/Math.PI:1; }
  function trg(r){ return Math.abs(r)<1e-12?0:r; }
  var FUNCS={
    "sin(":function(v){return trg(Math.sin(rd(v)));},
    "cos(":function(v){return trg(Math.cos(rd(v)));},
    "tan(":function(v){ if(deg&&Math.abs(v%180)===90) return NaN; return trg(Math.tan(rd(v))); },
    "asin(":function(v){return Math.asin(v)*dd();},
    "acos(":function(v){return Math.acos(v)*dd();},
    "atan(":function(v){return Math.atan(v)*dd();},
    "ln(":function(v){return v>0?Math.log(v):NaN;},
    "log(":function(v){return v>0?Math.log10(v):NaN;},
    "√(":function(v){return v>=0?Math.sqrt(v):NaN;}
  };
  function evaluate(t){
    var i=0;
    function peek(){ return t[i]; }
    function eat(){ return t[i++]; }
    function expression(){
      var v=term();
      while(peek()==="+"||peek()==="−"){ var o=eat(),r=term(); v=o==="+"?v+r:v-r; }
      return v;
    }
    function term(){
      var v=unary();
      while(peek()==="×"||peek()==="÷"){
        var o=eat(),r=unary();
        if(o==="÷"){ if(r===0) throw 0; v=v/r; } else v=v*r;
      }
      return v;
    }
    function unary(){
      var p=peek();
      if(p==="−"){ i++; return -unary(); }
      if(p==="+"){ i++; return unary(); }
      return power();
    }
    function power(){
      var b=post();
      if(peek()==="^"){ i++; return Math.pow(b,unary()); }
      return b;
    }
    function post(){
      var v=primary();
      for(;;){
        var p=peek();
        if(p==="²"){ i++; v=v*v; }
        else if(p==="!"){ i++; v=fact(v); }
        else if(p==="%"){ i++; v=v/100; }
        else if(p==="⁻¹"){ i++; if(v===0) throw 0; v=1/v; }
        else break;
      }
      return v;
    }
    function closer(){ if(peek()===")") i++; }
    function primary(){
      var p=eat();
      if(p===undefined) throw 0;
      if(isNum(p)) return parseFloat(p);
      if(p==="π") return Math.PI;
      if(p==="e") return Math.E;
      if(p==="("){ var v=expression(); closer(); return v; }
      if(FUNCS.hasOwnProperty(p)){ var a=expression(); closer(); return FUNCS[p](a); }
      throw 0;
    }
    var res=expression();
    if(i<t.length) throw 0;
    return res;
  }
  function equals(){
    if(err||justEq||!toks.length) return;
    var shown=toStr(),d=depth();
    while(d-->0) shown+=")";
    var val,res;
    try{ val=evaluate(toks.slice()); res=num(val); if(res==="Error") throw 0; }
    catch(e){ err=true; lastExpr=shown; result="Error"; sound("err"); render(); return; }
    lastExpr=shown; result=res; justEq=true;
    render();
  }
  function fn(f){
    sound("f");
    if(f==="sq"){ postfix("²"); return; }
    if(f==="fact"){ postfix("!"); return; }
    if(f==="inv"){ postfix("⁻¹"); return; }
    if(f==="pi"||f==="e"){
      begin(); if(endsOperand()) toks.push("×");
      toks.push(f==="pi"?"π":"e"); render(); return;
    }
    var m={sin:"sin(",cos:"cos(",tan:"tan(",asin:"asin(",acos:"acos(",atan:"atan(",ln:"ln(",log:"log(",sqrt:"√("};
    if(m[f]) openTok(m[f]);
  }
  var ctx=null,soundOn=true,mode="real",nb=null,skip=false,sbtn=document.getElementById("snd");
  try{ var sm=localStorage.getItem("calcSoundMode"); if(sm&&["real","mech","calc","beep","off"].indexOf(sm)>-1){mode=sm;soundOn=sm!=="off";} }catch(e){}
  function paintOld(){ sbtn.textContent=soundOn?"🔊":"🔇"; sbtn.setAttribute("aria-pressed",String(soundOn)); }
  function tone(freq,start,dur,type,vol){
    var t=ctx.currentTime+start,o=ctx.createOscillator(),g=ctx.createGain();
    o.type=type; o.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq,t);
    g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001,t);
    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(vol,t+0.005);
    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001,t+dur);
    o.connect(g); g.connect(ctx.destination); o.start(t); o.stop(t+dur+0.02);
  }
  var MODES=["real","mech","calc","beep","off"],ICON={real:"🧾",mech:"⌨️",calc:"🧮",beep:"🔊",off:"🔇"},LABEL={real:"Recorded calculator sound",mech:"Mechanical keyboard sound",calc:"Calculator sound",beep:"Beep sound",off:"Sound off"};
  function setMode(m){ mode=m; soundOn=m!=="off"; paintSnd(); }
  function paintSnd(){ sbtn.value=mode; }
  function ensureCtx(){
    if(!ctx){ var AC=window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext; if(!AC) return false; ctx=new AC(); }
    if(ctx.state==="suspended") ctx.resume();
    return true;
  }
  function nbuf(){
    if(!nb){ nb=ctx.createBuffer(1,Math.floor(ctx.sampleRate*0.2),ctx.sampleRate); var d=nb.getChannelData(0); for(var i=0;i<d.length;i++) d[i]=Math.random()*2-1; }
    return nb;
  }
  function click(t0,freq,q,dur,vol){
    var s=ctx.createBufferSource(),f=ctx.createBiquadFilter(),g=ctx.createGain(),t=ctx.currentTime+t0;
    s.buffer=nbuf(); f.type="bandpass"; f.frequency.value=freq; f.Q.value=q;
    g.gain.setValueAtTime(vol,t); g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001,t+dur);
    s.connect(f); f.connect(g); g.connect(ctx.destination); s.start(t,Math.random()*0.05); s.stop(t+dur+0.02);
  }
  function thump(t0,f0,f1,dur,vol){
    var o=ctx.createOscillator(),g=ctx.createGain(),t=ctx.currentTime+t0;
    o.type="sine"; o.frequency.setValueAtTime(f0,t); o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(f1,t+dur);
    g.gain.setValueAtTime(vol,t); g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001,t+dur);
    o.connect(g); g.connect(ctx.destination); o.start(t); o.stop(t+dur+0.02);
  }
var CLIPS={"down": ["", "", "", "", ""], "up": ["", "", "", "", ""]};
  var dBufs=[],uBufs=[],loaded=false;
  function b64buf(s){ var b=atob(s),u=new Uint8Array(b.length); for(var i=0;i<b.length;i++) u[i]=b.charCodeAt(i); return u.buffer; }
  function loadClips(){
    if(loaded) return; loaded=true;
    CLIPS.down.forEach(function(s){ ctx.decodeAudioData(b64buf(s),function(b){dBufs.push(b);},function(){}); });
    CLIPS.up.forEach(function(s){ ctx.decodeAudioData(b64buf(s),function(b){uBufs.push(b);},function(){}); });
  }
  function playBuf(buf,vol,rate){
    var s=ctx.createBufferSource(),g=ctx.createGain();
    s.buffer=buf; s.playbackRate.value=rate; g.gain.value=vol;
    s.connect(g); g.connect(ctx.destination); s.start();
  }
  function soundReal(k){
    try{
      if(!ensureCtx()) return;
      loadClips();
      if(k==="err"){ tone(150,.09,.25,"sawtooth",.07); return; }
      if(!dBufs.length){ click(0,3000,1.4,.03,.4); return; }
      var big=(k==="="||k==="0"||k==="\u232b"||k==="AC");
      playBuf(dBufs[Math.floor(Math.random()*dBufs.length)],1,(big?0.92:1)*(0.97+Math.random()*0.06));
    }catch(e){}
  }
  function playUp(){
    try{ if(!ctx||!uBufs.length) return; playBuf(uBufs[Math.floor(Math.random()*uBufs.length)],0.9,0.97+Math.random()*0.06); }catch(e){}
  }
  function release(){
    if(soundOn&&mode==="real"){ playUp(); return; }
    if(!soundOn||mode!=="mech"||!ctx) return;
    try{ click(0,3800*(0.92+Math.random()*0.16),2,.015,.14); }catch(e){}
  }
  function sound(k,direct){
    if(!soundOn) return;
    if(!direct&&skip){skip=false;return;}
    if(mode==="beep") return soundBeep(k);
    if(mode==="real") return soundReal(k);
    try{
      if(!ensureCtx()) return;
      if(k==="err"){ tone(150,.09,.25,"sawtooth",.07); return; }
      var r=0.92+Math.random()*0.16,big=(k==="="||k==="0"||k==="⌫"||k==="AC");
      if(mode==="mech"){
        click(0,3000*r,1.4,.03,.45);
        thump(0.004,(big?150:210)*r,big?55:75,.09,.6);
        click(0.016,1600*r,.9,.035,.3);
      } else {
        click(0,2000*r,2.5,.04,.4);
        thump(0,(big?260:340)*r,110,.05,.32);
        if(k==="=") click(0.03,1100*r,1.5,.05,.25);
      }
    }catch(e){}
  }
  function soundBeep(k){
    try{
      if(!ctx){ var AC=window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext; if(!AC) return; ctx=new AC(); }
      if(ctx.state==="suspended") ctx.resume();
      if(k===".") tone(700,0,.05,"sine",.12);
      else if(/^[0-9]$/.test(k)) tone(440+parseInt(k,10)*30,0,.05,"sine",.12);
      else if("+−×÷^".indexOf(k)>-1) tone(740,0,.07,"triangle",.12);
      else if(k==="="){ tone(660,0,.09,"sine",.15); tone(990,.08,.14,"sine",.15); }
      else if(k==="AC"||k==="⌫") tone(260,0,.1,"square",.05);
      else if(k==="err") tone(150,.09,.25,"sawtooth",.07);
      else if(k==="f") tone(880,0,.06,"sine",.12);
      else tone(600,0,.06,"triangle",.1);
    }catch(e){}
  }
  paintSnd();
  function press(k){
    sound(k);
    if(/^[0-9.]$/.test(k)) digit(k);
    else if("+−×÷^".indexOf(k)>-1) operator(k);
    else if(k==="=") equals();
    else if(k==="AC"){lastCalc="";clearAll();}
    else if(k==="%") postfix("%");
    else if(k==="±") sign();
    else if(k==="⌫") back();
    else if(k==="(") openTok("(");
    else if(k===")") closeParen();
  }
  document.getElementById("keys").addEventListener("click",function(e){
    var b=e.target.closest("button"); if(b) press(b.dataset.k);
  });
  document.getElementById("sci").addEventListener("click",function(e){
    var b=e.target.closest("button"); if(!b) return;
    if(b.dataset.f) fn(b.dataset.f); else if(b.dataset.k) press(b.dataset.k);
  });
  document.getElementById("deg").addEventListener("click",function(){
    deg=!deg;this.textContent=deg?"Deg":"Rad";
  });
  sbtn.addEventListener("change",function(){
    setMode(sbtn.value);
    try{ localStorage.setItem("calcSoundMode",mode); }catch(e){}
    sound("±");
  });
  function keyOf(b){ return b.dataset.k||(b.dataset.f?"f":"±"); }
  ["keys","sci"].forEach(function(id){
    document.getElementById(id).addEventListener("pointerdown",function(e){
      var b=e.target.closest("button"); if(!b) return;
      sound(keyOf(b),true); skip=true;
    });
  });
  function endPress(e){
    if(e.target.closest&&e.target.closest(".keys button, .sci button")) release();
    setTimeout(function(){skip=false;},30);
  }
  document.addEventListener("pointerup",endPress);
  document.addEventListener("pointercancel",function(){skip=false;});
  document.addEventListener("keyup",function(e){
    var k=e.key;
    if((k.length===1&&"0123456789.+-*/^=%()".indexOf(k)>-1)||k==="Enter"||k==="Backspace"||k==="Escape") release();
  });
  document.querySelector(".top").addEventListener("click",function(e){
    var b=e.target.closest("button"); if(b&&b.id!=="snd") sound("±");
  });
  document.getElementById("sciToggle").addEventListener("click",function(){
    document.getElementById("sci").classList.toggle("on");
  });
  var sel=document.getElementById("themeSel");
  function setTheme(t){ document.documentElement.dataset.theme=t; sel.value=t; }
  try{ var saved=localStorage.getItem("calcTheme"); if(saved&&sel.querySelector('option[value="'+saved+'"]')) setTheme(saved); }catch(e){}
  sel.addEventListener("change",function(){
    setTheme(sel.value);
    try{ localStorage.setItem("calcTheme",sel.value); }catch(e){}
  });
  document.addEventListener("keydown",function(e){
    var k=e.key,m={"*":"×","/":"÷","-":"−","+":"+","^":"^"};
    if(/^[0-9.]$/.test(k)) press(k);
    else if(m[k]){e.preventDefault();press(m[k]);}
    else if(k==="Enter"||k==="="){e.preventDefault();press("=");}
    else if(k==="Backspace") press("⌫");
    else if(k==="Escape") press("AC");
    else if(k==="%") press("%");
    else if(k==="("||k===")") press(k);
  });
  render();
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
